proposition.claim:
The paper links singular rational curves in del Pezzo surfaces to ellipsoid-embedding staircases. Upper bounds use inflation after cusp resolution; lower bounds use index-zero unicuspidal curves. Constructions use Orevkov twists and toric degenerations with \(T\)-singularities.

The conventions are material: curves are reduced and irreducible; \((p,1)\) permits a smooth distinguished point; sesquicuspidal curves can have ordinary double points away from the cusp, and weak algebraic variants allow further singularities. The normalization \([\omega]=c_1\) gives line area \(3\) in \(\mathbb{CP}^2\). The embedding function is an infimum. Theorem A uses \(c'>c\), not attainment at the limiting boundary. Stabilized lower bounds require the stated semipositivity input, satisfied in the monotone applications.
